# tree_at { #crossrepo.gitutil.tree_at }

```python
crossrepo.gitutil.tree_at(repo, rev, path)
```

Find the tree sha of a directory as of a revision.

A tree sha is a hash of the directory's whole content — every name, mode and
blob beneath it — so it identifies a dataset split across many files exactly
as a blob sha identifies a single file, and two identical datasets share one.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Union](`typing.Union`)\[[Location](`crossrepo.location.Location`), [Path](`pathlib.Path`), [str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Working tree to inspect, on this machine or another.

<code>[**rev**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Revision to read at, typically a commit sha.

<code>[**path**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository-relative path of the directory.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The tree sha, or `None` when `path` is not a directory at `rev`.
